caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a man standing on a rectangular pedestal base, facing forward with his left arm raised and his hand shielding his eyes as if looking into the distance. The man has tan skin and is dressed in clothing and accessories that suggest a Native American motif: he wears a feathered headdress with several large, gray feathers and a red headband, and his long dark hair falls to his shoulders. Around his neck is a circular medallion and a necklace of white items resembling animal teeth. A red and blue cloak is draped over his left shoulder and across his back, with the blue color on the inside and red on the outside. He is bare-chested except for an armband on his right upper arm and a belt at his waist holding a tomahawk and knife. His lower garment is a tan, fringed skirt that reaches his knees and covers part of his legs. Both his legs and feet are visible, and he wears moccasin-like footwear. In his right hand, he holds an object resembling a pipe or tool. The overall colors in the drawing include shades of brown, tan, red, blue, gray, and metallic gold, with black accents for detail and shadow. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
